title: Mapindu Ari Kupera Ekubudirira
intro: Munyika yakakomborerwa nezvinhu zvakawanda, nzanga yakabudirira, ichirarama pakati pezviratidzo zvenyasha dzaMwari. Kubudirira kwavo kwaive humbowo hwenyasha dzaIshe wavo, chipo chakagadzirirwa kukurudzira kutenda nekuteerera. Asi, pasinei nezviratidzo zvakajeka zvemakomborero avo, shanduko yakasvika, ichivanetsa kukoshesa kwavo kwaibva pfuma yavo huru nenyaradzo.
clues: Takakomborerwa nemapindu maviri, rimwe kurudyi nerimwe kuruboshwe, rakazara nezvibereko.
Takarayirwa kuti tidye kubva muzvipo zvaIshe wedu uye timutende nekuda kwenyika yakanaka uye Ishe anokanganwira.
Takatanga kuzvikudza uye takatsauka kubva munzira yekuonga, tichizvikudza nepfuma yedu nesimba redu.
Takakumbira kuti Ishe wedu awedzere daro pakati perwendo rwedu, tichiratidza kusada zororo raakanga aita.
Takanyeverwa nemutumwa, asi takaramba shoko racho tikaramba tisingateereri.
Dhamu redu guru, iro rakaita kuti tibudirire, rakazopedzisira raputsika, zvikaita kuti pave nemafashamo makuru.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Takapararira uye nyika yedu yakava isina chinhu
outcome.answer: Takapararira uye nyika yedu yakava isina chinhu

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
